tasks.label: Start database container
args: const fs=require('fs'),p='.env',sample='replace-this-with-a-random-secret-of-at-least-32-characters';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'),m=s.match(/^JWT_SECRET=(.*)$/m);if(m&&m[1].length>=32&&m[1]!==sample){console.log('Existing JWT_SECRET is valid; leaving it unchanged.');process.exit(0)}const secret=require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex');s=m?s.replace(/^JWT_SECRET=.*$/m,'JWT_SECRET='+secret):s+'\nJWT_SECRET='+secret+'\n';fs.writeFileSync(p,s);console.log('Generated a private JWT_SECRET in .env.')
